description: Stationnement cyclable 2026 (Le Mans Métropole) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Le Mans Métropole. This dataset meets the specifications of the Bicycle parking diagram: It consists of 825 lines with geographical coordinates XY. Its producer is the Mobility and Transport department, Active and Shared Mobility projects. Coverage: Le Mans Métropole. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle parking 2026 (Le Mans Métropole)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Le Mans Métropole. Its keywords include stationnement, cyclable. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-07-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
